title: feat(gen): serve the docs as Markdown to agents that ask for it
author: patbing

gist.summary: GET /docs now serves the full guide as Markdown when the Accept header prefers text/markdown, using the same body as /docs/llm.txt instead of the Scalar HTML shell. Content negotiation follows RFC 9110 specificity and quality rules: exact media types outrank text/* and */* matches, while browser headers and a bare */* retain HTML. Markdown responses include Vary: Accept, Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, and an advisory x-markdown-tokens estimate based on characters divided by four. GET / also serves the llms.txt body as text/markdown to agent clients; /llms.txt remains text/plain, and its interactive-docs entry now mentions the Accept header.
